blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump is now expected to arrive in the Philippines on Nov. 18 to 19, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez said on Saturday. “So far yes,” Romualdez told the Inquirer when asked whether the American leader was expected to visit Manila on those dates. The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) earlier announced that Trump was expected to arrive on Nov. 17 to participate in the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, which the Philippines is hosting from Nov. 15 to 17.
